summary: Frontend-only mobile test (390x844) as Owner, with the token added through the API. Operational Reports (wastage, inventory, purchases, opname) PASS: Excel/PDF/Cetak/Kirim WA render above the DateFilter (WA top 117px, date-filter top 161px). Clicking Kirim WA (window.open stubbed, nothing sent) opens a https://wa.me/?text= URL. The message has the uppercase report title, the range, 'Total catatan: N' and at most 10 detail rows (inventory: 27 records, 10 rows shown). No console errors. The bento-scrollable class is applied on report-products-table, operations-table, menu-stock-history and pos-dashboard-history, and the outer ::before gradient is hidden (display:none). Horizontal scroll works. FAIL: the orange gradient border on the scrollable table is NOT rendered. The computed border-image is set on table.table-x, but the table has border-collapse: collapse, and browsers ignore border-image on collapsed tables. Visual check: neither table shows an orange border. Injecting 'border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0' makes the gradient border appear around the table (verified by screenshot).

ui_bugs.issue: The gradient border-image does not render because .table-x uses border-collapse: collapse (Tailwind preflight). The table has no orange border and the outer bento border is gray, so the scrollable table now has no orange border.

issues: The <Empty> text is outside the <table>, so the border only wraps the header row. The empty text also scrolls horizontally with the content and gets cut off (e.g. 'n ada data pada periode ini' after scrolling).
It includes a date range line even though the inventory view has no DateFilter (it is a snapshot). Consider removing the line or labelling it 'Per tanggal'.

action_items: In index.css, add 'border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0;' to the .bento-scrollable .table-x rule so the border-image renders. Optionally add a border-radius, or use a wrapper div with the gradient border around the table.
Optional: render the empty state inside the bordered area (e.g. a tbody row with colSpan) so the border wraps the whole content.
Optional: drop the date range from the inventory WA message.
critical_code_review_comments: Bento adds bento-scrollable by string-matching className.includes('overflow-x-auto'). This is fragile; an explicit prop would be better.

The .bento-scrollable border-color uses hsl(--border), which is rgb(39,39,42) on the dark theme and almost invisible. That is acceptable, but together with the table border not rendering, the card looks borderless.
seed_data_creation: None. Only window.open was stubbed; no WA message was sent and no records were created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Log in via page.request: POST /api/auth/identify, then /api/auth/login. Put the token in localStorage (si4am_token, si4am_legal_2026-06-01=accepted, si4am_session_wib_date=WIB date), then goto /reports?view=wastage|inventory|purchases|opname. Stub window.open with add_init_script to capture the wa.me URL. To check the border visually, take an element screenshot of [data-testid=operations-table] or [data-testid=pos-dashboard-history]; the computed borderImageSource alone is not proof that the border renders.
